title: MegaMart

listing.shortDescription: A complete storefront and admin suite — React frontend with product browsing, cart and checkout, backed by an Express, JWT and MySQL API with social sign-in.
listing.fullDescription: MegaMart is a full-stack e-commerce platform built to handle the whole loop from catalog to sale. Customers browse and filter products, open detail views, manage a cart and check out, while an admin area manages the store. The Express API brings JWT auth, validation, file uploads and email, and Google and Facebook social sign-in round out the frontend.

closing.conclusion: MegaMart came together as a real storefront: customers browse, filter and check out while admins manage products and orders — a full loop from catalog to sale.
